subject_policy: neutral performer; do not transfer identity, face, costume, scene, dialogue, or original sound from references

reference_media.observed_content: 竖屏夜间教学；画面文字分段示范平落、内旋、体前画立圆、身后画立圆、内腕花、内外腕花与外腕花。可见单人持剑，以腕部和前臂带动剑身连续画圆，剑尖沿圆弧运行，剑身与末端挂件出现明显滞后、摆动和回弹。
evidence_limits: 教学段没有对手、拨械接触或受击反应；不能单独证明抽击的命中时机。
画面为固定教学机位，不能作为复杂运镜参考。

reference_media.observed_content: 横屏高帧率电影动作混剪；包含近景兵器交错、多人攻防、身体闪避、腾挪与击退，剪辑在近身接触、武器轨迹和受击反应处频繁切换，能提供动作节拍、接触后的位移和镜头跟随方向参考。
evidence_limits: 这是混剪，不能把采样帧当作连续单镜头或精确切点。
未将影片人物、服装、场景、对白、字幕或音乐转移到生成提示词。

reference_media.observed_content: 竖屏户外教学；先示范背剑转身、外腕花、转身接续和多段剑花连接，再把动作连续串联并提高速度。剑身围绕身体前侧、侧后方和上方改变方向，手腕翻转与身体转向同步，剑尖画出连续圆弧与回环。
evidence_limits: 主体为单人教学，没有对手、命中或拨械结果；不能直接作为受击时机参考。
教学字幕和示范节奏属于原视频内容，生成时只提取动作机制。

action_contract.target: one neutral training sword or padded weapon held by an off-screen opponent
action_contract.weapon: high-flex sword or whip-sword with visible blade-body flexibility
action_contract.starting_state: medium distance, sword held in front, target weapon visible across the center line

beats.description: normal speed or slight acceleration; front foot enters and torso leans in
wrist and forearm snap forward; blade middle section leads while tip lags
blade bends and rebounds through a whip-like wave; contact remains readable
serpentine afterimage, air-rip lines and several linear impact sparks; target weapon or actor moves along the force direction
blade recoil is controlled and the performer faces the target in a ready recovery

action_contract.audio: sharp whoosh followed by a short whip crack and metallic vibration tail
forbidden_interpretations: do not turn this into blade-to-blade Beat / Attack au Fer
do not turn this into Coupé or a straight thrust
do not add blood, wounds, extra characters, or a new scene

prompt_cn: 生成一条4秒、16:9的中性武术动作参考视频，只展示一名成年剑术表演者使用高韧性剑或鞭剑完成‘抽击·剑鞭拨械’。中景、简洁无特征训练空间、固定或轻微跟随镜头，不继承任何参考视频的人物、服装、场景、字幕、音乐或对白。0.00-0.60秒保持正常速度或略微加速，前脚切入并探身；0.60-1.10秒手腕和前臂短促爆发，剑身中段先行、剑尖因惯性滞后；1.10-1.60秒剑身明显抖动、弯曲并回弹，沿波浪、S形或鞭状轨迹完成可读接触；1.60-2.40秒出现蛇形残影、细小空气撕裂线和多段线性火花，受击训练武器或演员沿受力方向移动；2.40-4.00秒控制剑身回弹并面向目标收势。动作保持实时速度，不使用慢动作；抽击不是拍刃，不是剑身对剑身碰撞，不是Coupé绕剑刺击。
prompt_en: Generate a 4-second 16:9 neutral martial-arts action reference video showing one adult sword performer using a highly flexible sword or whip-sword for elastic sword whiplash striking. Medium shot in a simple featureless training space, fixed or lightly following camera. Do not transfer any actor, face, costume, location, subtitle, music, or dialogue from the reference videos. 0.00-0.60s: real-time or slightly accelerated entry, front foot steps in and the torso leans forward. 0.60-1.10s: a short wrist-and-forearm snap drives the motion; the middle of the blade leads while the tip lags from inertia. 1.10-1.60s: the blade visibly vibrates, bends, and rebounds through a readable wave, S-curve, or whip-like path. 1.60-2.40s: serpentine ghost trails, fine air-rip lines, and several linear impact sparks appear as the training weapon or performer moves along the force direction. 2.40-4.00s: the performer controls the blade recoil and faces the target in a ready recovery. Keep real-time motion, no slow motion. This is elastic sword whiplash, not blade-to-blade Beat / Attack au Fer and not Coupé cutover thrusting.
